summary: Iteration 65 — verified expanded Catholic World Map (now 133 sites / 62 countries) + companion devotions on every vocation companion (with i18n). Backend (9/9 pytest passing): GET /api/sites returns exactly 133 items across 62 countries, with site_id uniqueness; seed idempotent across back-to-back calls (total stays 133, no duplicate site_ids). The persecuted contract is unchanged: exactly 6 sites have persecuted=true, each with non-empty persecution_note. The five new spec slugs all resolve via GET /api/sites/{slug}: st-nicholas-bari (Bari, Italy), turin-cathedral (Turin, Italy — Holy Shroud), divine-mercy-krakow (Kraków, Poland), medjugorje (Bosnia and Herzegovina), santo-nino-cebu (Cebu, Philippines) — each returns non-empty name/country/city/history and numeric lat/lng. GET /api/vocation/guide returns companions[] where every companion (4 for marriage, 4 for religious life, 4 for singleness) has a non-empty devotions[] of {title, body}; St Joseph (marriage default) has 3 devotions. Accept-Language: es and it both localize companion devotions (titles/bodies differ from EN) via the shared translation cache (warmed once on localhost in ~8s; subsequent calls instant). After the localized fetches, EN companion devotions are unchanged — confirms _build_guide's deepcopy keeps module CONTENT immutable. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /vocation — selecting vocation-companion-st-joseph reveals testID=companion-devotions-st-joseph containing 'Ways to grow closer to St. Joseph' + 'Keep Wednesdays for St. Joseph' + 'Pray the Litany or Chaplet of St. Joseph'. Tapping vocation-companion-gianna-molla swaps the block: joseph block disappears, companion-devotions-gianna-molla appears. /community/map → map-toggle-list renders the new sites: map-list-turin-cathedral, map-list-divine-mercy-krakow, map-list-medjugorje, map-list-st-nicholas-bari, map-list-santo-nino-cebu all present; tapping turin-cathedral and divine-mercy-krakow each opens the detail sheet (map-close visible; screenshot confirms 'Sanctuary of Divine Mercy, Kraków · Kraków, Poland · 1891 / 2002' with relics + Learn more + Close). Test account RESET to vocation=marriage / vocation_state=living / companion_saint=st-joseph at the end. No critical issues.
